name: shared-helper-export-syntax
goal: Recognize standalone exported helper arrows without mistaking parenthesized values for functions.

evidence: Typed and single-parameter exported arrows are helpers; parenthesized values, private functions, types and class methods are not.

History projection covers named functions. The generated metadata unit needs a reusable source-shape matrix for arrow declarations, non-callable exports, shared versus feature-local paths, revision changes and missing files.
3dd02df7: unchanged metadata source-shape matrix fails: typed and single-parameter arrows are missing and a parenthesized constant is falsely callable.

Export scanning reads past variable type annotations and checks for the arrow token; parenthesized value expressions remain constants. Both parenthesized and single-parameter helper arrows retain their signatures.
